description: This file defines the MultipartStream class, which implements a streaming multipart/form-data payload generator used for HTTP requests. It constructs multipart streams with specified form elements, headers, and boundaries, facilitating uploads like file transfers within the Guzzle HTTP client library.

classes.name: MultipartStream
classes.description: A class to generate and stream multipart/form-data content, supporting multiple form elements with headers and optional filenames, to facilitate file uploads and complex multipart HTTP requests.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the MultipartStream with form elements and an optional boundary, creating the underlying stream for the multipart payload.

methods.name: getBoundary
methods.description: Returns the boundary string used in the multipart stream.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Indicates whether the stream is writable; returns false.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Constructs headers for each part of the multipart stream, including boundary delimiters.

methods.name: createStream
methods.description: Creates the combined stream for all elements, including the closing boundary.

methods.name: addElement
methods.description: Adds a form element to the multipart stream, setting headers like Content-Disposition, Content-Length, and Content-Type.

methods.name: createElement
methods.description: Builds individual multipart elements with appropriate headers based on filename, contents, and provided headers.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Utility method to fetch a specific header value case-insensitively from headers array.
